conclusion: The reusable protocol, memory, queue, and signal state can be linked as an independent control core when the target is registered before the VEGA_X86-gated SimObject path and uses BUILD_ISA=n with USE_X86_ISA=n.
decision: Keep HOSTGPU_NATIVE_CONTROL as a small standalone control-plane target and reuse the same state sources; defer GPU SimObjects, PT_LOAD mapping, and decoder execution to the next adapter gate.
invalidated_assumptions: A BUILD_GPU target necessarily requires a VEGA_X86 CPU/system build.
Removing one USE_X86_ISA setting proves the full GPU pipeline is host-native.
observation: The mold/24 HOSTGPU_NATIVE_CONTROL build links and the ELF audit reports BUILD_ISA=n, USE_X86_ISA=n, allowed host libraries, and no forbidden x86 or GPU-pipeline undefined symbols.
question_or_symptom: Can existing gem5 host state be reused without starting the x86 simulator?
